title: Evaluation of ultrasound-based predictive models for disease relapse in rheumatoid arthritis patients in clinical remission.
summary: Prospective ultrasound-based models predicted disease relapse in rheumatoid arthritis patients in clinical remission using multivariate clinical factors, with the cohort, comparison and evaluation reported in the full text. Interpretation stays with the reported study; no broader clinical benefit follows.
